[[File:Large altara_map.png|thumb|150px|Molvaine Gap in central Altara.]]
The '''Molvaine Gap''' is a well known five-mile wide passage through the [[Damona Mountains]] that contains part of the [[Great North Road]], known as the [[Lugard]] road in this region. Just short of the Gap is the [[Malvide Narrows]], a popular place for bandit attacks.
